iOS/iPadOS: Smarter device-aware source selection and source recovery. Long-paused HTTP playback resumes its existing stream before bounded reconnect. Subtitles align silently with release matching and no progress banners. Opt-in telemetry adds safe playback startup, video codec and pause-failure evidence. Recommendations filter completed films and duplicates. Portable settings track revisions. Device-local Flat/Dialogue/Cinema/Warm audio presets and new regression tests included.
